lines.t: Beloved children, you turned away from Life
You left forgiveness standing at your side
You closed the door where mercy used to shine
And walked into the shadow of the night
Why have you forsaken Me?
Why have you turned your face?
I called you through the silence
But you would not receive My grace
My heart is bleeding sorrow
For the works your hands have done
I search your hearts and minds now
Yet you keep on trying to run
Great and bitter mourning
Like a storm that will not cease
My children have departed
Far away from Me
Anguish takes hold as I behold your ways
You build upon the dust of empty days
My outstretched hand has waited in the air
But still you choose the darkness and despair
Why have you forsaken Me?
Why reject the voice of truth?
I offered life and healing
Yet you chose to lose your youth
My heart is bleeding sorrow
For the works your hands have done
I search your hearts and minds now
Yet you keep on trying to run
Great and bitter mourning
Like a storm that will not cease
My children have departed
Far away from Me
Deep mourning fills the heavens
As judgment draws near
The hand once stretched for rescue
Now reveals what you have feared
Return before the breaking
Return while mercy calls
Return before destruction
Comes upon the walls
My heart is bleeding sorrow
Yet My love has not grown cold
I see the grief before you
I see the path you chose
Great and bitter sorrows
Unending grief and pain
My children, come back home now
Call upon My name
Why have you forsaken Me?
Why have you gone away?
Beloved children, hear Me—
Return to Me today…
